title: OG Extraction but with Relics
description: The original Caravan Heroes extraction loop (heroes keep their own abilities) where stat potions are replaced by one-time relics: ⏩ Double Turn, ↩️ Go Back and 🛡️ Shield. Pick a squad, equip starter relics, then fight across the map from the spawn node. Win to gain 2 relics; lose and every relic is gone. Turn-based: your side always strikes first, and there are no ties.
